end.summary:
Named Bishnoi communities and khejri-tree protection.
Identified sacred groves and Chipko as nature-protecting traditions.
Explored neem as a way to repel insects and baori as rainwater storage.
Teach-back was not passed; links between traditional practices and scientific explanations need more practice.
end.parentNote: Dev practised examples of traditional nature protection, including Bishnoi, sacred groves, Chipko, neem, and baoris. They used observations such as trees reducing soil erosion and neem being linked with fewer insects. Dev mixed up how to clearly connect traditional knowledge with scientific explanation, and this was not fully corrected by the end of the lesson. At home, ask Dev to choose one practice and complete: “It protects ___ because ___; science can explain this by ___.”
